comment: VRAM copy regions of wide512 for docs/ROM_LAYOUT.md: [char0, 16-word chunk count] in descriptor order. The tile region (values are genroms.py SPRITE_SCENES wide512['tiles']) and the SG pattern block (cell $80, 22 cells = 1408 words at VRAM $2000, #70: the wide picture's sprites and its 18-strip line need it in the viewer). Read by tools/genviewer.py and renderer/pce-rom.js; the SAT at VRAM $7f00 is NOT a region - it has its own fixed place in bank 1.
